thumbnail_brief: Archetype B food-chain pyramid that darkens as it climbs: bright bands at the base, the great white on deep navy and the sperm whale on deep red, and the orca alone on a near-black apex band in front of a flat red halo (boss band). Mantis shrimp mid-strike in the bottom band with a small Doug in his snail costume (red cap visible) beside it, looking up the whole climb, so the title promises the deaths and the thumbnail shows the ladder he has to climb; labels are animal names only and must not use Every, Step, Ocean, Food, Chain, Kill or Doug.
description:
Doug climbs the ocean food chain one predator at a time, dressed as each one's favourite prey: a mantis shrimp whose punch hits twice, a moray with a second set of jaws, a fish that catches birds in mid-air, the polar bear, the great white, the sperm whale, and the orca, the top predator that even great white sharks flee from.

Which predator should Doug meet next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad day.
